   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Choisir les paramètres \n",
    "* minimum support, maximum itemset length pour l'algorithme apriori"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 116,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Cette fonction est utile pour présenter visuellement le dataset, la distribution de nombre d'article\n",
    "def meaningful_item_size(tc):\n",
    "    num_items_per_transaction = pd.Series(tc.sum(axis=1))\n",
    "    dis_num_items = num_items_per_transaction.value_counts()\n",
    "    plt.scatter(dis_num_items.index, dis_num_items.values)\n",
    "    plt.xlabel(\"Nombre d'articles dans les paniers\")\n",
    "    plt.ylabel(\"Nombre de transaction correspondant\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "    plt.close()\n",
    "    return dis_num_items"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 117,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "\n",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "itemset_size = meaningful_item_size(df)"
   ]
  },

   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Le choix \"secure\" est de ne pas prendre des groupes d'individus inférieurs à 1% du dataset (min_sup=0.01)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 121,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Nombres correspondants: [45, 75, 105, 135, 375]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "choix_min_support = [0.006,0.010, 0.014, 0.018, 0.05]\n",
    "print(\"Nombres correspondants:\", [int(choix_min_support[i]*df.shape[0]) for i in range(len(choix_min_support))])"
   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "* On constate qu'avec faible minimum support, 0.01, on a 75 clients min"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Premier étape: trouver les itemset_fréquent avec apriori"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 122,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from mlxtend.frequent_patterns import apriori"
   ]

    "result_df = pd.DataFrame({'minsup':choix_min_support, 'num_items': num_freq_itemset, 'itemsets':freq_itemsets})\n",
